# Publication API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

An article or preprint, linked to the projects it reports on.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/dissemination/publication/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/dissemination/publication/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `publication` (detail, create, update), `publications` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `title` unique across BrainSTEM

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `title` | string **[required]**; max 200 characters |
| `authors` | string **[required]**; max 500 characters |
| `journal` | [`journal`](/api/dissemination/journal/) id **[required]** |
| `abstract` | string **[required]** |
| `doi` | string; max 200 characters |
| `publication_url` | string; max 300 characters |
| `pdf_url` | string; max 300 characters |
| `publication_date` | date **[required]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/dissemination/publication/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('publication', load_all=True)
records = resp['publications']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('publication', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.publications;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "publications": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "title": "",
            "authors": "",
            "journal": "<journal-id>",
            "abstract": "",
            "doi": "",
            "publication_url": "",
            "pdf_url": "",
            "publication_date": "2024-03-22",
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/dissemination/publication/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('publication', data={"title": "<title>", "authors": "<authors>", "journal": "<journal-id>", "abstract": "<abstract>", "publication_date": "2024-03-22"})
record = resp.json()['publication']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('title', '<title>', 'authors', '<authors>', 'journal', '<journal-id>', 'abstract', '<abstract>', 'publication_date', '2024-03-22'), 'publication');
record = created.publication;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/dissemination/publication/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('publication', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['publication']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('publication', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.publication;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "publication": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "title": "",
        "authors": "",
        "journal": "<journal-id>",
        "abstract": "",
        "doi": "",
        "publication_url": "",
        "pdf_url": "",
        "publication_date": "2024-03-22",
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/dissemination/publication/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('publication', id='<id>', data={"title": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'title', 'new value'), 'publication', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/dissemination/publication/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('publication', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'publication');
```

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Publication data model page](/datamodel/dissemination/publication/).
